data.name: Fabrin
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Fabrin is derived from the root word 'phbero', meaning 'to carry, bring forth'. This name was given to those who helped others grow, especially in a spiritual sense. In Christian tradition, Fabrin represents the nurturing and growth of the soul under the guidance of God.

In Christian culture, it takes on a deeper spiritual meaning, representing the role of a spiritual guide or mentor in nurturing and guiding others in their faith journey.

Fabrin signifies the divine influence of a loving and caring God, who nurtures and guides His people, and the role of the Christian in bringing forth the spiritual growth of those around them.
